name: 247Studio
summary: A monochrome agency style built from white canvas, black ink typography, muted gray supporting copy, large display grotesk, flat rounded cards, hairline borders, and print-like spacing.

pureWhite.role: Page canvas, card surface, inverted text

inkBlack.role: Primary text, logo, borders, strong labels, dark buttons

obsidian.role: Dark sections, footer, inverted editorial surfaces

graphiteWash.role: Dark panels, overlays, secondary dark surfaces

slate.role: Secondary body copy and muted UI

steel.role: Tertiary text, captions, grayscale logo tints

fog.role: Muted hero line, inactive indicators, pale support copy

paleMist.role: Hairline borders, disabled states, field outlines

vapor.role: Soft dividers, card fill, input fill, placeholders

ash.role: Alternating section bands and image placeholders

components.hero: Two-line left-aligned display headline with black first line, gray italic second line, and narrow body copy below.
components.clientLogoCell: Low white grid cell with tiny numbered metadata, centered grayscale logo, and 1px vapor divider.
components.officeCard: Rounded white card with pale border, image placeholder, compact label, address lines, and underlined email.
components.documentaryLabel: Rotated 10px uppercase side label with a quiet hairline rule.
components.sectionEyebrow: Flush-left compact uppercase display label with 40px bottom margin.
components.brandMark: Custom 247 mark using display face and ss01 alternate, black on light and white on dark.

dos: Keep the palette strictly black, white, and neutral gray.
Use typography and whitespace as the main expressive tools.
Keep body copy narrow and sparse.
Use large rounded surfaces with hairline borders.
Use flat tonal shifts instead of shadows.
donts: Do not introduce a colored CTA.
Do not add gradients, glows, or decorative color.
Do not make content dense just to fill the page.
Do not flatten the logo mark into a generic system font wordmark.
